title: The Internet Is Changing Its Mind on Maxxing Mania
claim: Newsweek reports Pulsar data: anti-maxxing ('counter-maxxing') talk has overtaken pro-maxxing; anti-maxxers embrace being 'good enough'.
excerpt: 'Pro-maxxing' volume keeps growing, but 'counter-maxxing' is growing even faster - and has now overtaken it.
